compute_matching.budget: A0 profile token budget times declared matmul-heavy training FLOPs per token
compute_matching.limitations: analytic estimate excludes operators; never claim complete hardware-compute matching

data.historical_seed_91001_manifest_status: NOT_PRESENT_LOCALLY; use explicitly identified controlled-retrain corpus
data.holdout_policy: 384 nonoverlapping 129-token spans excluding all validation spans; same frozen offsets for every model

g1_selection.selection: lowest validation NLL among eligible A1/A2/A3; holdout reported but never used for selection

g2.B3_B4: frozen-weight read/write ablations on task-trained B2; not independent structural training
g2.execution_control: B0/B1/B2 and all G3 arms use identical fixed_chunk32 training scheduling; G1 retains legacy parallel reference

g3.C3: retain Cellular State; choose integer dense Stage-2 SwiGLU width nearest C2 allocated parameter count; compute difference separately
g3.capacity_note: Rank 16 chosen by pre-training structural parameter accounting to keep C2 within +/-5% of original X4; stateless C1 lacks state-network parameters and remains explicitly unmatched.
g3.parameter_warning: routing variants may exceed +/-5% parameter target; report mismatch, do not claim parameter matching

mechanisms.G3_gate: correctness PASS plus task gain over B0 and read/write ablation contribution; candidate signal, not scientific confirmation
mechanisms.delay: larger than exact configured attention receptive field plus two Chunks
mechanisms.loss: query target only; observed input tokens reported separately

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: fixed LR, one pass, 128 query-target updates; separate from language schedule

mechanisms.tbptt: entire mechanism episode; no detach before delayed query

multi_seed_followup: at least three separately authorized independent training seeds; no automatic confirmation-seed consumption

streaming_semantics.position: absolute RoPE, never renumber on sliding; boundaries at absolute position mod 32
streaming_semantics.reference: legacy exact within 128; extended absolute-position local-window reference explicitly distinct from truncated-history recomputation
streaming_semantics.snapshot: model/tokenizer identities, absolute position, persistent state, per-iteration KV, partial Chunk buffer, generator RNG

training.detach_policy: independent 125-token random stream sample resets Session each optimizer update; no detach at internal 32-token write boundaries
training.resume_policy: no optimizer checkpoint recovery; failed model restarts fresh; final weights saved once
